description: THE ORGANIZER'S OR THE HOSTS' NOTICE TO PASS HOLDERS. Call it when the organizer of an event, or a host of a personal event, wants to tell the people who added the event pass to their phone's Wallet something: "doors open at 7 now", "the keynote moved to Hall B", "Sonar meetup at The Bar on 2nd at 8 PM". Each pass holder in the chosen group sees the line on their lock screen (Apple Wallet shows it as the pass's own change notice; Google Wallet shows it as a Wallet notification) and the line stays on the pass. Pass `audience` to say WHO: everyone, one ticket tier, one badge intent, an explicit list of pass serials, the people who scanned at a booth, or the people who answered an earlier meetup notice yes or no. A MEETUP is a notice with a place: pass `placeLabel` and, when you have them, `latitude` and `longitude`, so the pass surfaces again on the lock screen near that place reading "Sonar meetup inside, show this pass."; pass `at` for the hour. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm`: the reply is a PREVIEW with the number of passes in the group and the exact lock-screen line, and nothing is sent. Read both back and send only when the organizer says so, by calling again with `confirm: true`. Only the hosts or the organizer of the event can send; anybody else is refused and you read the refusal out as given. The vendor audience "my_booth" is switched off by ruling and is refused with VENDOR_OFF. Six notices an hour per event; a seventh is refused with RATE_LIMITED. It reaches pass holders only, it never tells anybody who else is there, and it never reports that a person arrived. It requires a personal connector token.

at.description: OPTIONAL, for a meetup: the hour, as a full timestamp with a time zone ("2027-06-12T20:00:00-07:00").

audience.description: REQUIRED. WHO the notice is for. "everyone" is every pass of the event; "tier" one ticket tier (pass `tier`); "intent" one badge intent (pass `intent`); "serials" an explicit list (pass `serials`); "booth" the people who scanned at a booth the organizer names (pass `boothId`); "meetup_yes" or "meetup_no" the people who answered an earlier meetup notice (pass its `noticeId`). "my_booth" is a vendor sending to their own leads and is switched off by ruling: it is refused with VENDOR_OFF, say so and do not retry.

boothId.description: For audience "booth" or "my_booth": the booth id.

confirm.description: Leave out for a PREVIEW: the reply says how many passes the group holds and the exact lock-screen line, and nothing is sent. Read that back, and only when the organizer says to send it call again with confirm: true.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or the event name as the organizer or the hosts spell it.

intent.description: For audience "intent": Buyer, Vendor, Networker or Social.

latitude.description: OPTIONAL, for a meetup: the place's latitude. Both coordinates or neither.

longitude.description: OPTIONAL, for a meetup: the place's longitude. Both coordinates or neither.

noticeId.description: For audience "meetup_yes" or "meetup_no": the noticeId an earlier meetup notice answered with.

placeLabel.description: OPTIONAL, for a meetup: the name of the place ("The Bar on 2nd"). With `latitude` and `longitude` the pass surfaces on the lock screen when the person is near it.

relevantText.description: OPTIONAL, for a meetup with coordinates: the line the lock screen shows NEAR the place. Default: "Sonar meetup inside, show this pass."

requestId.description: OPTIONAL. Your own id for this notice; the same id never sends twice.

serials.description: For audience "serials": the pass serial numbers, at most fifty.

text.description: REQUIRED. The notice, one plain line of up to 120 characters, in the organizer's words. This exact line is what the lock screen shows. No links, no markup.

tier.description: For audience "tier": general, vendor or host.

name: event_pass_notice
title: Send a notice to a group of pass holders (hosts and organizers only)
